name: testcaptive-chrome-extension
description: TestCaptive UI behavior recording Chrome extension

scripts.zip: node -e "const AdmZip = require('adm-zip'); const zip = new AdmZip(); zip.addLocalFolder('dist'); zip.writeZip('testcaptive-chrome-extension.zip'); console.log('✅ Extension packaged: testcaptive-chrome-extension.zip');"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true }); console.log('✅ Cleaned dist folder');"
